programmes.d: Henry and Charlotte discover things are not what they seem when Captain Man suddenly announces his plans to marry.
Henry and Charlotte want to tell Jasper that Henry is really Kid Danger, so they decide to give him a test secret to prove that he is ready.
Henry and Charlotte are in charge of protecting Swellview while Ray is out of town at his cousin's wedding.
When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair.
When Kid Danger and Captain Man battle the Time Jerker, Kid Danger accidentally falls into the Time Jerker's time machine and relives the same day over again.
A 13-year-old boy lands a job as a sidekick to a superhero, and he must now keep his identity a secret.
Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.

When Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's, they compete to win the title of manager; after seeing how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his advanced age, Lincoln takes him out for a day to remember.

Lincoln must beat each of his sisters to the couch in order to watch the finale of his favorite show; Lincoln leaves a scathing voicemail on Lori's phone, and quickly realizes that he must erase it before she hears it.
Lincoln is tired of his sisters' meddling until he is being picked on at school; Lincoln records his sisters' most embarrassing moments.

Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter.
Lynn desperately wants to win a basketball championship but gets drafted onto a terrible team; Mom and Dad decide to build a secret bathroom after they become sick of waiting their turn in line.
Luan is locked in a cell in the basement; Mom goes undercover as a student at the high school and becomes best friends with Leni, Luna and Luan.

Lori and Lincoln visit the city, where Lori struggles to be a city girl; Lincoln finds that Ronnie Anne has changed; the family uses stunt doubles in its plan to avoid Luan's April Fool's Day pranking.

Lincoln's social standing is at stake when his four-year-old sister is put into his fifth grade class; the children grow tired of their family van falling apart, so they decide to try to trick Dad into buying a cool, new van.
Luan turns to Mr. Coconuts for help after she struggles to direct her school's play; Lisa joins Lynn's football team as the analytics coach to prove that math will always beat out heart.
Lincoln and the gang are trapped in the woods with Mr. Bolhofner, who may not be who he says he is; Lana gets more than she bargained for when she takes on Stella.

Luna pranks the entire household every year on April Fools' Day, but this year Lincoln has a plan to avoid her pranks; the Loud children make a trip to the supermarket to do the grocery shopping for their mother, but Lincoln has other plans.

Lincoln and Clyde must start a business for a class assignment, so they decide to sell Lincoln's girl expertise; the children are determined to out-sell each other at the Loud family's annual garage sale.
SpongeBob's breath smells after he eats sea onion ice cream; Mr. Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at Krusty Krab.
Sandy and SpongeBob compete doing underwater sports; SpongeBob and Patrick visit the zoo.
After the heater breaks, the trio's apartment freezes; Paper tries to save his friends; Lou attends Landlord Con; Paper joins Rock and Scissors in a prank war against the Rat Bros and Pencil.

The trio goes on an unnecessarily action-packed adventure with Paper's sister, Sandpaper, to get seven key limes; when Rock's TV dinner isn't as plentiful as advertised, he fights for justice; Scissors works for the company.
Timmy and Chloe help the depressed Catman prove to his girlfriend that he is a real superhero; Mr. Crocker teaches his nephew Kevin Crocker how to become a Fairy Hunter.
Timmy and Chloe wish that their families go camping together, but there is a feud between their parents. Chloe wishes to be a mother so she can go to Dimmsdale Daze Carnival with Timmy.

Mr. Crocker creates Wonky Cosmo and Wanda clones to get into a Fairy Convention to steal all the fairies' magic; Timmy wishes Chloe could live out her favorite dystopian movie but quickly regrets it when everyone is hungry.

When Cosmo loses the wands after Timmy and Chloe switch places, they risk being stuck as each other; Timmy and his father have some time to bond when they enter a film festival, but things get out of hand when Dad casts Catman.
After Timmy and Chloe save Dark Laser's beloved pet, Dark Laser becomes bound to them as their bodyguard; Timmy and Chloe wish up a girlfriend for Mr. Crocker to get him off their backs.

When Chloe's goodness threatens to drain the Anti-Fairy World Wand, Foop disguises himself as a girl in order to break Chloe; Timmy takes Chloe to meet Mark Chang so he can prove that aliens really do exist.
Timmy and Chloe must come to the rescue when Chloe's parents decide to return Cosmo and Wanda, who disguised themselves as birds, to their natural habitat.
Chloe wishes that an animal resembling Mr. Crocker would no longer be endangered; Timmy, Chloe and the fairies go inside Mr. Crocker to destroy Fairy Flu germs.

Chloe thinks she has a rash caused by stress and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her; Dad wants to catch a fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.
Chloe's favorite cartoon characters come to life and brainwash Timmy and Wanda; Timmy's enemies learn that he is helpless without his fairies and try to destroy him while he is weak.
Chloe joins the Squirrely Scouts and saves the troop by helping them get their first merit badge; when Timmy and Chloe find out they have the same birthday, they decide to compete for the best party.

When Catman thinks Timmy has been kidnapped, he mistakes Chloe for Catgirl and enlists her help to save Timmy; when Timmy wishes that his father could be Mayor, he ends up getting tortured by the paparazzi and risks having his fairies discovered.

Timmy finds out that he has to share his fairies with the new girl in school, Chloe Carmichael, but when Chloe realizes she can use her magic for good, she wishes everyone in Dimmsdale would share everything, and chaos ensues.
Timmy and his fairies must save the city when Foop decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing everyone's pets with evil pets.
When Poof has trouble falling asleep, Wanda tries to help by reading him a book of classic fairy tales.
The gang searches through Cosmo's memories of his teenage years to discover why he never graduated from the Fairy Academy.
When Cosmo and Wanda bring Timmy back through time to meet their former Godchildren, his interactions with them alter the future.

When Dad forgets all the supplies for the Squirrely Scouts camping trip, Timmy tries to smooth things over with scary stories around a campfire.
Mr. Crocker becomes a teacher at the Fairy Academy; Poof begins to learn how to talk.
Poof finally becomes a fairy godparent, but unfortunately, he is assigned to Mrs. Crocker.
After deciding she wants to be an actress, Vicky forces Timmy to help her get her first role; Dad flushes Timmy and the fairies down the toilet.
Crocker pretends to be future Timmy using stolen DNA; Timmy and the others chip in to help Cosmo find his lost wand.
Timmy helps Jorgen find a new job after he is fired; Sparky makes his own magic dog treats.
Sparky is forbidden from dating Dinkleberg's new dog; Timmy wishes all women away to end Mom's constant nagging.
Dad starts a neighborhood watch program; Timmy tries to win a contest by wishing that he had the perfect family.
Mr. Krabs' mother starts to date; SpongeBob wants to make his own version of the "Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy" movie.
SpongeBob takes Mr. Krabs' daughter to the prom; SpongeBob and Squidward compete to be employee of the month.
SpongeBob and Patrick intrude upon Squidward's day off; Squidward becomes obsessed with winning a stuffed animal from the skill crane.
Plankton invents a machine enabling him to switch lives with Mr. Krabs; SpongeBob volunteers for lifeguard duty.
Stardom goes to SpongeBob's head after he appears in Krabs' low-budget commercial; Squidward becomes impoverished.
While working the graveyard shift, Squidward tells SpongeBob a scary story about the Hash Slinging Slasher; Mr. Krabs is smitten with Ms. Puff.
SpongeBob takes his turn as hall monitor; SpongeBob brings home a wild jellyfish.
Patrick and Squidina report the news around Bikini Bottom; "The Patrick Show!" presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.
Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together after being taken away by mistake; Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show.
A famous Internet celebrity invites Captain Man and Kid Danger to his party, but the party does not turn out the way they expected; Charlotte baby-sits Piper.
